        stop_event = execute_task(task, actions)
        data = load_state()
        data["tasks"][task["task_id"]] = task
        save_state(data)
        if stop_event:
            threading.Thread(target=run_actions, args=(task["task_id"], task["robot_id"], actions, stop_event), daemon=True).start()
    return {"ok": True, "task": task_public(task)}


def query_status(task_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with LOCK:
        task = load_state().get("tasks", {}).get(task_id)
    if not task:
        raise ApiError("unknown task_id", code="unknown_task")
    return {"ok": True, "task": task_public(task)}


def cancel_task(task_id: str, reason: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with LOCK:
        data = load_state()
        task = data.get("tasks", {}).get(task_id)
        if not task:
            raise ApiError("unknown task_id", code="unknown_task")
        stop_event = STOP_EVENTS.get(task_id)
        if stop_event:
            stop_event.set()
        process = RUNNING_PROCESSES.get(task_id)
        if process and process.poll() is None:
            process.terminate()
        send_stop(task["robot_id"])
        task["state"] = "cancelled"
        task["reason"] = reason[:120]
        task["updated_at"] = time.time()
        save_state(data)
    return {"ok": True, "task": task_public(task)}


def reassign_task(task_id: str, robot_id: str, reason: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with LOCK:
        data = load_state()
        task = data.get("tasks", {}).get(task_id)
        if not task:
            raise ApiError("unknown task_id", code="unknown_task")
        if task["state"] not in ("pending", "blocked"):
            raise ApiError("only pending or blocked tasks can be reassigned", 409, "task_not_reassignable")
        assignment = ZONE_ASSIGNMENTS[task["zone"]]
        if robot_id not in (assignment["primary"], assignment["backup"]):
            raise ApiError("robot is not assigned to this zone", code="zone_robot_mismatch")
        status = run_readonly_status()
        if not robot_online(status, robot_id):

        task["robot_id"] = robot_id
        task["state"] = "pending"

FORMATIONS = {"square", "line", "triangle", "circle", "diamond"}
MISSIONS = {"formation", "translate-then-line", "square-turn"}
MOTION_MODES = {"sequential", "synchronized"}
TURN_DIRECTIONS = {"auto", "left", "right"}


class RequestError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, status: int = 400, code: str = "invalid_request"):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status = status
        self.code = code


STATE: dict[str, Any] = {
    "job_id": None,
    "state": "idle",
    "started_at": None,
    "finished_at": None,
    "exit_code": None,
    "request": None,
    "log_path": None,
    "report_path": None,
    "result": None,
    "message": "ready",
}
PROCESS: subprocess.Popen[str] | None = None
LOG_STREAM: Any = None


def number(value: Any, name: str, minimum: float, maximum: float) -> float:
    try:
        result = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise RequestError(f"{name} must be a number") from exc
    if result < minimum or result > maximum:
        raise RequestError(f"{name} must be between {minimum} and {maximum}")
    return result


def validate_start(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    formation = str(payload.get("formation", "square")).strip().lower()
    mission = str(payload.get("mission", "formation")).strip().lower()
    motion_mode = str(payload.get("motion_mode", "sequential")).strip().lower()
    turn_direction = str(payload.get("turn_direction", "auto")).strip().lower()
    if formation not in FORMATIONS:
        raise RequestError("unsupported formation")
    if mission not in MISSIONS:
        raise RequestError("unsupported mission")
    if motion_mode not in MOTION_MODES:
        raise RequestError("unsupported motion_mode")
    if turn_direction not in TURN_DIRECTIONS:
        raise RequestError("unsupported turn_direction")
    return {
        "formation": formation,
        "mission": mission,
        "motion_mode": motion_mode,
        "spacing": number(payload.get("spacing", 0.5), "spacing", 0.3, 2.0),
        "timeout": number(payload.get("timeout", 360), "timeout", 30, 900),
        "travel": number(payload.get("travel", 1.0), "travel", 0.1, 3.0),
        "straight": number(payload.get("straight", 0.6), "straight", 0.1, 2.0),
        "turn_radius": number(payload.get("turn_radius", 0.4), "turn_radius", 0.3, 2.0),
        "turn_direction": turn_direction,
        "cruise_speed": number(payload.get("cruise_speed", 0.15), "cruise_speed", 0.05, 0.30),
    }


def command_for(request_value: dict[str, Any], check_only: bool = False, validate_motion: bool = False) -> list[str]:
    command = [
        "cmd.exe",
        "/d",
        "/c",
        str(RUNNER),
        request_value["formation"],
        "--spacing",
        str(request_value["spacing"]),
    ]
    if check_only:
        command.append("--check-only")
        return command
    command.extend([
        "--mission",
        request_value["mission"],
        "--motion-mode",
        request_value["motion_mode"],
        "--timeout",
        str(request_value["timeout"]),
        "--travel",
        str(request_value["travel"]),
        "--straight",
        str(request_value["straight"]),
        "--turn-radius",
        str(request_value["turn_radius"]),
        "--turn-direction",
        request_value["turn_direction"],
        "--cruise-speed",
        str(request_value["cruise_speed"]),
    ])
    if validate_motion:
        command.append("--validate-motion")
    return command


def run_preflight() -> dict[str, Any]:
    with LOCK:
        if PROCESS is not None and PROCESS.poll() is None:
            raise RequestError("a formation job is running", 409, "job_running")
    request_value = validate_start({})
    deployment = subprocess.run(command_for(request_value, check_only=True), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90, check=False)
    if deployment.returncode != 0:
        raise RequestError(deployment.stdout[-4000:] + deployment.stderr[-4000:], 503, "deployment_check_failed")
    acceptance = subprocess.run([str(ACCEPTANCE_PYTHON), str(ACCEPTANCE_SCRIPT)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90, check=False)
    if acceptance.returncode != 0:
        raise RequestError(acceptance.stdout[-4000:] + acceptance.stderr[-4000:], 503, "stationary_check_failed")
    return {"ok": True, "deployment": deployment.stdout.strip(), "stationary": acceptance.stdout.strip()}


def start_job(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    global PROCESS, LOG_STREAM
    request_value = validate_start(payload)
    with LOCK:
        if PROCESS is not None and PROCESS.poll() is None:
            raise RequestError("a formation job is running", 409, "job_running")
    validation = subprocess.run(
        command_for(request_value, validate_motion=True),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
        check=False,
    )
    if validation.returncode != 0:
        output = validation.stdout[-4000:] + validation.stderr[-4000:]
        lowered = output.lower()
        if any(token in lowered for token in ("does not fit", "unsafe", "collision free", "outside_arena", "path blocked")):
            raise RequestError(output, 409, "insufficient_clearance")
        if any(token in lowered for token in ("localization", "pose missing", "pose stale", "telemetry invalid")):
            raise RequestError(output, 503, "localization_unavailable")
        if "lidar" in lowered or "scan" in lowered:
            raise RequestError(output, 503, "lidar_unavailable")
        if any(token in lowered for token in ("service", "ssh unavailable", "motor output gate")):
            raise RequestError(output, 503, "robot_service_unavailable")
        raise RequestError(output, 409, "motion_validation_failed")
    with LOCK:
        if PROCESS is not None and PROCESS.poll() is None:
            raise RequestError("a formation job is running", 409, "job_running")
        job_id = f"formation-{time.strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
        LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        log_path = LOG_DIR / f"{job_id}.log"
        LOG_STREAM = log_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8")
        PROCESS = subprocess.Popen(
            command_for(request_value),
            cwd=str(KIT_ROOT),
            stdout=LOG_STREAM,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            text=True,
            creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP,
        )
        STATE.update({
            "job_id": job_id,
            "state": "running",
            "started_at": time.time(),
            "finished_at": None,
            "exit_code": None,
            "request": request_value,
            "log_path": str(log_path),
            "report_path": None,
            "result": None,
            "message": "formation job started",
        })
        threading.Thread(target=watch_job, args=(PROCESS, log_path), daemon=True).start()
        return {"ok": True, "job": public_state()}


def watch_job(process: subprocess.Popen[str], log_path: Path) -> None:
    global LOG_STREAM
    exit_code = process.wait()
    if LOG_STREAM is not None:
        LOG_STREAM.close()
        LOG_STREAM = None
    result = None
    report_path = None
    message = "formation job completed" if exit_code == 0 else "formation job failed"
    for line in log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
        if line.startswith("FORMATION_RESULT "):
            result = json.loads(line.removeprefix("FORMATION_RESULT "))
        elif line.startswith("FORMATION_REPORT "):
            report_path = line.removeprefix("FORMATION_REPORT ").strip()
        elif line.startswith("AUTO_FORMATION_FAILED:"):
            message = line.strip()
    with LOCK:
        STATE.update({
            "state": "complete" if exit_code == 0 else "failed",
            "finished_at": time.time(),
            "exit_code": exit_code,
            "report_path": report_path,
            "result": result,
            "message": message,
        })


def stop_job() -> dict[str, Any]:
    with LOCK:
        process = PROCESS
        if process is None or process.poll() is not None:
            return {"ok": True, "job": public_state(), "already_stopped": True}
        process.send_signal(signal.CTRL_BREAK_EVENT)
        STATE["state"] = "stopping"
        STATE["message"] = "stop requested"
        return {"ok": True, "job": public_state(), "already_stopped": False}


def public_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = dict(STATE)
    log_path = value.get("log_path")
    value["recent_output"] = ""
    if log_path and Path(log_path).is_file():
        value["recent_output"] = Path(log_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")[-8000:]
    return value


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, fmt: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        return

    def send_json(self, status: int, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        raw = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(raw)

    def body(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
        if length <= 0 or length > 65536:
            raise RequestError("request body size is invalid")
        value = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode("utf-8"))
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise RequestError("request body must be an object")
        return value

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        if self.path == "/api/v1/health":
            self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "service": "formation-executor", "runner": str(RUNNER), "runner_exists": RUNNER.is_file()})
        elif self.path == "/api/v1/capabilities":
            self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "formations": sorted(FORMATIONS), "missions": sorted(MISSIONS), "motion_modes": sorted(MOTION_MODES)})
        elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/status":
            with LOCK:
                self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "job": public_state()})
        else:
            self.send_json(404, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "not found"}})

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        try:
            payload = self.body()
            if self.path == "/api/v1/formation/preflight":
                response = run_preflight()
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/start":
                response = start_job(payload)
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/stop":
                response = stop_job()
            else:
                raise RequestError("not found", 404, "not_found")
            self.send_json(200, response)
        except RequestError as exc:
            self.send_json(exc.status, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": exc.code, "message": str(exc)}})
        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
            self.send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "invalid_json", "message": str(exc)}})


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="VelaMecanum formation executor API")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="0.0.0.0")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8766)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if any(token in content for token in ("path blocked", "blocked by lidar", "does not fit", "unsafe", "collision free", "outside_arena")):
        return "前方受阻，执行已停止"
    if any(token in content for token in ("localization", "pose missing", "pose stale", "telemetry invalid", "localization uncertain")):
        return "定位异常，执行已停止"
    if "lidar" in content or "scan" in content:
        return "雷达异常，执行已停止"
    if any(token in content for token in ("service", "offline", "ssh unavailable", "connection refused", "telemetry stream stalled")):
        return "控制服务异常，执行已停止"
    if any(token in content for token in ("too close", "minimum separation", "below minimum separation")):
        return "车辆间距不足，执行已停止"
    if "timeout" in content:
        return "任务超时，执行已停止"
    if any(token in content for token in ("made less than", "did not reach forwarding", "lease renewal")):
        return "车辆运动异常，执行已停止"
    return "编队任务失败，执行已停止"


def start_monitor(args, result):
    job = result.get("job") or {}
    job_id = str(job.get("job_id") or "")
    if not job_id:
        return
    log_path = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "formation_voice_monitor.log"
    stream = log_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8")
    subprocess.Popen(
        [sys.executable, str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve()), "monitor", "--base-url", args.base_url, "--job-id", job_id],
        stdout=stream,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
        start_new_session=True,
    )
    stream.close()


def monitor_job(args):
    while True:
        result = request_json(args.base_url, "GET", "/api/v1/formation/status")
        job = result.get("job") or {}
        if str(job.get("job_id") or "") != args.job_id:
            return 0
        state = job.get("state")
        if state == "complete":
            return 0
        if state == "failed":
            message = runtime_failure_message(str(job.get("message") or ""))
            import tts
            tts.say(message, voice="Cherry", block=True, verbose=True)
            return 11
        time.sleep(1.0)


def start_payload(args):
    return {
        "formation": args.formation,
        "spacing": args.spacing,
        "mission": args.mission,
        "straight": args.straight,
        "turn_radius": args.turn_radius,
        "turn_direction": args.turn_direction,
        "cruise_speed": args.cruise_speed,
        "timeout": args.timeout,
    }


def speak_status(result):
    job = result.get("job") or {}
    state = job.get("state") or "unknown"
    messages = {
        "idle": "编队控制已经连接，当前没有运行任务",
        "running": "编队任务正在运行",
        "stopping": "编队任务正在停止",
        "complete": "编队任务已经完成",
        "failed": "编队任务运行失败",
    }
    return messages.get(state, "编队任务状态无法识别")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="语音控制与编队接口连接程序")
    parser.add_argument("action", choices=["start", "status", "stop", "preflight", "monitor"])
    parser.add_argument("--base-url", default=DEFAULT_BASE_URL)
    parser.add_argument("--formation", default="square")
    parser.add_argument("--spacing", type=float, default=0.5)
    parser.add_argument("--mission", choices=["formation", "square-turn"], default="formation")
    parser.add_argument("--straight", type=float, default=0.6)
    parser.add_argument("--turn-radius", type=float, default=0.4)
    parser.add_argument("--turn-direction", choices=["auto", "left", "right"], default="auto")
    parser.add_argument("--cruise-speed", type=float, default=0.15)
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=360)
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--job-id", default="")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.action == "monitor":
        if not args.job_id:
            raise ValueError("monitor requires --job-id")
        return monitor_job(args)

    command_names = {
        "start": "START_FORMATION",
        "status": "STATUS",
        "stop": "STOP",
        "preflight": "PREFLIGHT",
    }
    payload = start_payload(args) if args.action == "start" else {}
    if args.dry_run:
        if args.action == "start":
            if not 0.3 <= args.spacing <= 2.0:
                raise ValueError("spacing must be between 0.3 and 2.0")
            if not 0.1 <= args.straight <= 2.0:
                raise ValueError("straight must be between 0.1 and 2.0")
            if not 0.3 <= args.turn_radius <= 2.0:
                raise ValueError("turn_radius must be between 0.3 and 2.0")
            if not 0.05 <= args.cruise_speed <= 0.30:
                raise ValueError("cruise_speed must be between 0.05 and 0.30")
        print("cmd=%s payload=%s" % (
            command_names[args.action],
            json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True),
        ))
        return 0

    try:
        if args.action == "start":
            result = request_json(args.base_url, "POST", "/api/v1/formation/start", payload)
            start_monitor(args, result)
            message = "编队任务已经启动"
        elif args.action == "status":
            result = request_json(args.base_url, "GET", "/api/v1/formation/status")
            message = speak_status(result)
        elif args.action == "stop":
            result = request_json(args.base_url, "POST", "/api/v1/formation/stop", {})
            message = "编队停止指令已经发送"
        else:
            result = request_json(args.base_url, "POST", "/api/v1/formation/preflight", {})
            message = "编队运行条件检查通过"
    except FormationRequestError as exc:
        message = rejection_message(exc.code, str(exc))
        print(json.dumps({"ok": False, "error": {"code": exc.code, "message": str(exc)}}, ensure_ascii=False))
        print("@@SPEAK@@%s" % message)
        return 10

    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
    print("@@SPEAK@@%s" % message)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""voice_errors.py — 语音助手"出错就用语音说一句"。

为什么非做不可（实测踩到的）
--------------------------
云端不通时，助手会**卡 90 秒然后一声不吭**。日志里明明写着
「🎤 听到唤醒词『小陈』」→ 录到了音 → `识别失败：transcribe.py timed out after
90 seconds`，但用户那边**听不到任何反馈**，只能以为"喊了没反应"。
排障全靠 SSH 看日志 —— 在现场这是不可接受的。

三条设计原则
------------
1. **先快后慢**：识别前做一次几秒的连通性预检。不通就立刻说"网络不通"，
   而不是等 ASR 超时 90 秒才出声。
2. **一定要有声音**：TTS 本身也走云端，网络不通时它**必然也失败**。
   所以每种错误都配一段**本地提示音**（板载扬声器，零依赖），先响提示音，
   再尝试 TTS 补一句人话。
3. **话要短**：现场噪音大、注意力有限，"网络不通"远好过
   "urlopen error [Errno 113] No route to host"。

额外一招：**把错误话术预合成进 TTS 缓存**（`--presynth-errors`）。
tts.py 的缓存是磁盘文件，联网时合成一次，之后**离线也能播** ——
这样"网络不通"这句话本身仍然能用语音说出来。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import socket
import threading
import time

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ 错误表
# kind: (要说的话, 提示音频率列表)
#   提示音：两声下行短音 = 可恢复的小问题；三声下行 = 明显故障；
#           先升后降 = 安全拦截（跟正常的上行音区分开）。
ERRORS = {
    "net":      ("网络不通",             [700, 560, 440]),
    "asr":      ("识别失败",             [700, 560, 440]),
    "asr_to":   ("识别超时",             [700, 560, 440]),
    "nohear":   ("没听清",               [760, 620]),
    "nomatch":  ("没听懂",               [760, 620]),
    "unsafe":   ("这条指令不安全",       [900, 620, 420]),
    "noaction": ("这条指令还没配置",     [700, 560]),
    "execfail": ("执行失败",             [700, 560, 440]),
    "vcmderr":  ("命令解析出错",         [700, 560, 440]),
    "micbusy":  ("麦克风被占用",         [560, 440, 340]),
    "recfail":  ("录音失败",             [560, 440, 340]),
    "nomic":    ("没听到声音",           [760, 620]),
    "nocar":    ("小车联系不上",         [700, 560, 440]),
    "clearance": ("距离不足，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
    "localization": ("定位异常，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
    "lidar": ("雷达异常，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
    "service": ("服务异常，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
    "busy": ("任务占用，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
    "params": ("参数不符合要求，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
    "conditions": ("条件不足，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
}
DEFAULT = ("出错了", [700, 560, 440])

# 需要预合成的话术（联网时跑一次，之后离线也能播）
PRESYNTH = [ERRORS[k][0] for k in sorted(ERRORS)]

# 预检结果缓存：短时间内的连续失败不必反复重试（每次要几秒）
_CACHE = {"t": 0.0, "ok": True, "why": "", "ttl": 8.0}


def _hostport(proxy):
    """把 'http://192.168.1.100:7890' 拆成 ('192.168.1.100', 7890)。"""
    s = proxy.strip()
    if "://" in s:
        s = s.split("://", 1)[1]
    s = s.split("/", 1)[0]
    if "@" in s:                      # 带认证的代理
        s = s.rsplit("@", 1)[1]
    host, _, port = s.partition(":")
    try:
        return host, int(port or 80)
    except ValueError:
        return host, 80


def _tcp_ok(host, port, timeout):
    try:
        s = socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=timeout)
        s.close()
        return True
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False


def _dns_ok(host, timeout):
    """只做解析。注意 `setdefaulttimeout` **管不住** getaddrinfo，
    所以这个函数只适合"单独想看是不是 DNS 的问题"，不要放在快路径上。"""
    old = socket.getdefaulttimeout()
    try:
        socket.setdefaulttimeout(timeout)
        socket.getaddrinfo(host, 443, proto=socket.IPPROTO_TCP)
        return True
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False
    finally:
        socket.setdefaulttimeout(old)


def _probe_once(timeout, host):
    """真正探一次。返回 (bool, 原因)。"""
    proxy = (os.environ.get("https_proxy") or os.environ.get("HTTPS_PROXY")
             or os.environ.get("http_proxy") or os.environ.get("HTTP_PROXY") or "")
    if proxy:
        # 有代理就查代理 —— 本机实测就是靠 192.168.1.100:7890 出去的，
        # 代理一挂，云端 ASR 和 TTS 会**一起**废掉。
        h, p = _hostport(proxy)
        if not _tcp_ok(h, p, timeout):
            return False, "代理 %s:%d 连不上" % (h, p)
        return True, ""
    try:
        s = socket.create_connection((host, 443), timeout=timeout)
        s.close()
        return True, ""
    except socket.gaierror:
        return False, "域名解析失败"
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False, "连不上云端（%s）" % type(exc).__name__


def net_ok(timeout=4.0, use_cache=True, host="dashscope.aliyuncs.com"):
    """云端走不走得通。返回 (bool, 原因)。结果缓存几秒，避免连续失败反复重试。

    【为什么要开线程】`getaddrinfo` **不受 socket 超时约束**，某些环境下
    光解析就能卡十几秒（本机实测 12 秒），那样"快预检"就名不副实了。
    这里给整次探测套一道**硬期限**；期限内没结论就返回"通"（=不拦），
    让后面的 ASR 自己去试 —— 宁可偶尔慢一次，也不要误拦掉正常的一轮。
    """
    now = time.time()
    if use_cache and (now - _CACHE["t"]) < _CACHE["ttl"]:
        return _CACHE["ok"], _CACHE["why"]

    box = {}

    def _run():
        try:
            box["r"] = _probe_once(timeout, host)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            box["r"] = (True, "")          # 探测本身出错就不拦
            box["err"] = str(exc)

    th = threading.Thread(target=_run, daemon=True)
    th.start()
    th.join(timeout + 1.5)
    if "r" not in box:
        # 没在硬期限内得出结论：不拦，交给 ASR 去试（并把结果短暂缓存）
        _CACHE.update(t=now, ok=True, why="")
        return True, ""
    ok, why = box["r"]
    _CACHE.update(t=now, ok=ok, why=why)
    return ok, why


def text_of(kind, extra=""):
    """要说的话 —— **只返回短句**。

    详细原因（"代理 192.168.1.100:7890 连不上"这种）只写进日志，**不念出来**：
    现场噪音大，念一长串 IP 和英文错误反而听不清重点，用户只需要知道
    "哪一类问题"。要细节看日志。
    """
    return ERRORS.get(kind, DEFAULT)[0]


def tones_of(kind):
    return ERRORS.get(kind, DEFAULT)[1]


def report(kind, beep_fn=None, say_fn=None, enabled=True, detail="",
           verbose=False):
    """把一条错误报出来：**先响本地提示音，再试语音**。

    beep_fn(tones)  : 播放一串频率，必须不依赖网络（板载扬声器）
    say_fn(text)    : 走 TTS；缓存命中时离线也能播
    detail          : 给日志用的详细原因，**不会被念出来**
    任何一个失败都不抛异常 —— 报错功能本身绝不能把主流程带崩。
    返回实际要说的话（便于写进日志/JSONL）。
    """
    text = text_of(kind)
    if detail and verbose:
        print("  [err] %s（详情：%s）" % (text, detail))
    if not enabled:
        return text
    # 1) 本地提示音：一定发得出来，先给用户一个"我出错了"的信号
    if beep_fn is not None:
        try:
            beep_fn(tones_of(kind))
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            if verbose:
                print("  [err] 提示音失败：%s" % exc)
    # 2) 再试语音。离线时若缓存里有这句，仍然能播出来。
    if say_fn is not None:
        try:
            say_fn(text)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            if verbose:
                print("  [err] 语音播报失败：%s" % exc)
    return text


def presynth(verbose=True):
    """把错误话术预合成进 tts 缓存（联网时跑一次，之后离线可播）。"""
    import sys
    sys.path.insert(0, "/home/sunrise/voice_pipeline")
    try:
        import tts
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        print("  载入 tts 失败：%s" % exc)
        return 0, 0
    ok = bad = 0
    for s in PRESYNTH:
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            p = tts.synth(s)
            print("  ✅ 「%s」-> %s（%.1fs）" % (s, os.path.basename(str(p)),
                                              time.time() - t0))
            ok += 1
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("  ❌ 「%s」失败：%s" % (s, exc))
            bad += 1
    return ok, bad


def selftest():
    print("=== voice_errors 自测 ===")
    ok = bad = 0
    for k in sorted(ERRORS):
        msg, tones = ERRORS[k]
        if not msg or not tones:
            bad += 1
            print("  ❌ %s 缺内容" % k)
            continue
        if len(msg) > 20:
            bad += 1
            print("  ❌ %s 话术太长（%d 字）：%s" % (k, len(msg), msg))
            continue
        ok += 1
        print("  ok   %-9s 「%s」 提示音 %s" % (k, msg, tones))
    # 拆代理字符串
    cases = [("http://192.168.1.100:7890", ("192.168.1.100", 7890)),
             ("https://user:pw@10.0.0.1:8080", ("10.0.0.1", 8080)),
             ("127.0.0.1:3128", ("127.0.0.1", 3128))]
    for s, want in cases:
        got = _hostport(s)
        if got == want:
            ok += 1
            print("  ok   _hostport(%r) = %s" % (s, got))
        else:
            bad += 1
            print("  ❌ _hostport(%r) = %s，应为 %s" % (s, got, want))
    # 连通性预检（真实执行一次）
    t0 = time.time()
    good, why = net_ok(timeout=4.0, use_cache=False)
    print("  预检：%s%s（%.1fs）"
          % ("通" if good else "不通", ("：" + why) if why else "", time.time() - t0))
    ok += 1
    print()
    print("自测：%d 通过，%d 失败" % (ok, bad))
    return bad == 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys
    if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "--presynth":
        o, b = presynth()
        sys.exit(0 if b == 0 else 1)
    sys.exit(0 if selftest() else 1)

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile
import threading
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid
from http import HTTPStatus
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/home/sunrise/velaguard")
PIPELINE = Path("/home/sunrise/voice_pipeline")
STATE_FILE = ROOT / "data" / "task_api.json"
ROBOTS = PIPELINE / "robots.json"
ROUTE_PLANS_FILE = Path(os.environ.get("VELAGUARD_ROUTE_PLANS", str(ROOT / "data" / "routes.json")))
FORMATION_EXECUTOR_URL = os.environ.get("VELAGUARD_FORMATION_EXECUTOR_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8766").rstrip("/")
LOCK = threading.RLock()
RUNNING_PROCESSES: dict[str, subprocess.Popen[str]] = {}
STOP_EVENTS: dict[str, threading.Event] = {}

ZONE_ASSIGNMENTS = {
    "entrance": {"primary": "Robot01", "backup": "Robot02", "route": "R-01"},
    "corridor": {"primary": "Robot02", "backup": "Robot01", "route": "R-02"},
    "exhibit": {"primary": "Robot03", "backup": "Robot04", "route": "R-03"},
    "device": {"primary": "Robot04", "backup": "Robot03", "route": "R-04"},
}
ROBOT_NUMBERS = {f"Robot{index:02d}": str(index) for index in range(1, 5)}
ALLOWED_ACTIONS = {
    "FORWARD": "distance_m",
    "BACKWARD": "distance_m",
    "STRAFE_LEFT": "distance_m",
    "STRAFE_RIGHT": "distance_m",
    "TURN_LEFT": "angle_deg",
    "TURN_RIGHT": "angle_deg",
    "STOP": None,
}
ACTION_LIMITS = {"distance_m": 3.0, "angle_deg": 180.0}


class ApiError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, status: int = 400, code: str = "invalid_request"):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status = status
        self.code = code


def hardware_output_enabled() -> bool:
    return os.environ.get("VELAGUARD_HARDWARE_OUTPUT", "0") == "1"


def load_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        data = json.loads(STATE_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {"tasks": {}}
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError):
        return {"tasks": {}}


def save_state(data: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    STATE_FILE.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".task-api-", suffix=".tmp", dir=str(STATE_FILE.parent))
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
            json.dump(data, stream, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
        os.replace(path, STATE_FILE)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(path):
            os.unlink(path)


def load_route_plans() -> dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]]:
    if not ROUTE_PLANS_FILE.is_file():
        return {}
    try:
        value = json.loads(ROUTE_PLANS_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ApiError(f"route plan file is invalid: {exc}", 503, "route_plan_invalid") from exc
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ApiError("route plan file must contain an object", 503, "route_plan_invalid")
    plans: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
    for route, actions in value.items():
        if not isinstance(route, str) or not isinstance(actions, list):
            raise ApiError("route plan entries must be arrays", 503, "route_plan_invalid")
        plans[route] = [validate_action(item) for item in actions]
    return plans


def validate_action(value: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ApiError("route action must be an object", 503, "route_plan_invalid")
    command = str(value.get("command", "")).upper()
    if command not in ALLOWED_ACTIONS:
        raise ApiError(f"unsupported route action: {command}", 503, "route_plan_invalid")
    parameter = ALLOWED_ACTIONS[command]
    result: dict[str, Any] = {"command": command}
    if parameter is None:
        return result
    try:
        amount = float(value[parameter])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise ApiError(f"route action requires {parameter}", 503, "route_plan_invalid") from exc
    if amount <= 0 or amount > ACTION_LIMITS[parameter]:
        raise ApiError(f"{parameter} must be greater than 0 and at most {ACTION_LIMITS[parameter]}", 503, "route_plan_invalid")
    result[parameter] = amount
    return result


def run_readonly_status() -> dict[str, Any]:
    command = ["python3", str(PIPELINE / "check_cars.py"), "--json"]
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15, check=False)
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
        raise ApiError(f"car status probe failed: {exc}", 503, "status_probe_failed") from exc
    json_line = next((line for line in completed.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("{")), None)
    if not json_line:
        raise ApiError("car status probe returned no JSON", 503, "status_probe_invalid")
    try:
        result = json.loads(json_line)
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise ApiError("car status probe returned invalid JSON", 503, "status_probe_invalid") from exc
    return {"source": "check_cars.py", "exit_code": completed.returncode, **result}


def robot_online(status: dict[str, Any], robot_id: str) -> bool:
    number = ROBOT_NUMBERS.get(robot_id)
    if not number:
        raise ApiError(f"unknown robot_id: {robot_id}", code="unknown_robot")
    return number in {str(item) for item in status.get("online", [])}


def task_public(task: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return dict(task)


def formation_executor_request(method: str, path: str, payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    body = None
    headers = {"Accept": "application/json"}
    if payload is not None:
        body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
    request = urllib.request.Request(FORMATION_EXECUTOR_URL + path, data=body, headers=headers, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
            value = json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        raw = exc.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        try:
            upstream = json.loads(raw)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            upstream = {}
        error = upstream.get("error") if isinstance(upstream, dict) else {}
        if not isinstance(error, dict):
            error = {}
        code = str(error.get("code") or "formation_executor_rejected")
        message = str(error.get("message") or raw or "formation executor rejected request")
        raise ApiError(message, exc.code, code) from exc
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ApiError(f"formation executor unavailable: {exc}", 503, "formation_executor_unavailable") from exc
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise ApiError("formation executor returned an invalid response", 503, "formation_executor_invalid")
    return value


def command_for_action(robot_id: str, action: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
    command = ["python3", str(PIPELINE / "ros_car.py"), "--robots", ROBOT_NUMBERS[robot_id], "--cmd", action["command"]]
    parameter = ALLOWED_ACTIONS[action["command"]]
    if parameter is not None:
        command.extend(["--set", f"{parameter}={action[parameter]}"])
    return command


def send_stop(robot_id: str) -> None:
    if not hardware_output_enabled():
        return
    subprocess.run(
        ["python3", str(PIPELINE / "ros_car.py"), "--robots", ROBOT_NUMBERS[robot_id], "--cmd", "STOP"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=20,
        check=False,
    )


def execute_task(task: dict[str, Any], actions: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> threading.Event | None:
    if not hardware_output_enabled():
        task["state"] = "blocked"
        task["reason"] = "hardware_output_disabled"
        return None
    if not actions:
        task["state"] = "blocked"
        task["reason"] = "route_executor_unconfigured"
        return None
    task["state"] = "running"
    task["reason"] = "route_execution_started"
    task["actions"] = actions
    stop_event = threading.Event()
    STOP_EVENTS[task["task_id"]] = stop_event
    return stop_event


def run_actions(task_id: str, robot_id: str, actions: list[dict[str, Any]], stop_event: threading.Event) -> None:
    try:
        for action in actions:
            if stop_event.is_set():
                return
            process = subprocess.Popen(command_for_action(robot_id, action), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
            with LOCK:
                RUNNING_PROCESSES[task_id] = process
            while process.poll() is None:
                if stop_event.wait(0.2):
                    process.terminate()
                    process.wait(timeout=5)
                    return
            output = process.stdout.read()[-2000:] if process.stdout else ""
            if process.returncode != 0:
                update_task(task_id, "blocked", f"route_action_failed:{action['command']}", process.returncode, output)
                return
        update_task(task_id, "done", "route_execution_completed", 0, "")
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
        update_task(task_id, "blocked", f"route_execution_failed:{exc}", None, "")
    finally:
        with LOCK:
            RUNNING_PROCESSES.pop(task_id, None)
            STOP_EVENTS.pop(task_id, None)


def update_task(task_id: str, state: str, reason: str, exit_code: int | None, output: str) -> None:
    with LOCK:
        data = load_state()
        task = data.get("tasks", {}).get(task_id)
        if not task:
            return
        if task.get("state") != "running":
            return
        task["state"] = state
        task["reason"] = reason
        task["updated_at"] = time.time()
        if exit_code is not None:
            task["command_exit_code"] = exit_code
        if output:
            task["command_output"] = output
        save_state(data)


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    server: ThreadingHTTPServer

    def log_message(self, fmt: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        return

    def send_json(self, status: int, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        raw = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(raw)

    def body(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        try:
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
            value = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode("utf-8"))
        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
            raise ApiError("request body must be UTF-8 JSON", code="invalid_json") from exc
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ApiError("request body must be a JSON object")
        return value

    def do_OPTIONS(self) -> None:
        self.send_response(HTTPStatus.NO_CONTENT)
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Headers", "Content-Type")
        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Methods", "GET, POST, OPTIONS")
        self.end_headers()

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        try:
            if self.path == "/api/v1/health":
                self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "service": "velaguard-task-api", "hardware_output_enabled": hardware_output_enabled()})
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/capabilities":
                self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "capabilities": {"actions": ["dispatch_task", "query_status", "cancel_task", "reassign_task"], "zones": ZONE_ASSIGNMENTS, "robots": list(ROBOT_NUMBERS), "route_plans": sorted(load_route_plans()), "hardware_output_enabled": hardware_output_enabled(), "safety_exit": "ros_car.py"}})
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/status":
                self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "status": run_readonly_status()})
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/status":
                self.send_json(200, formation_executor_request("GET", "/api/v1/formation/status"))
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/tasks":
                with LOCK:
                    self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "tasks": list(load_state().get("tasks", {}).values())})
            else:
                self.send_json(404, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "not found"}})
        except ApiError as exc:
            self.send_json(exc.status, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": exc.code, "message": str(exc)}})

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        try:
            payload = self.body()
            if self.path == "/api/v1/tasks":
                result = dispatch(payload)
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/tasks/status":
                result = query_status(str(payload.get("task_id", "")))
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/tasks/cancel":
                result = cancel_task(str(payload.get("task_id", "")), str(payload.get("reason") or "operator_cancel"))
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/tasks/reassign":
                result = reassign_task(str(payload.get("task_id", "")), str(payload.get("robot_id", "")), str(payload.get("reason") or "operator_reassign"))
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/preflight":
                result = formation_executor_request("POST", "/api/v1/formation/preflight", payload)
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/start":
                result = formation_executor_request("POST", "/api/v1/formation/start", payload)
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/stop":
                result = formation_executor_request("POST", "/api/v1/formation/stop", payload)
            else:
                raise ApiError("not found", 404, "not_found")
            self.send_json(200, result)
        except ApiError as exc:
            self.send_json(exc.status, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": exc.code, "message": str(exc)}})
        except Exception as exc:
            self.send_json(500, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "internal_error", "message": str(exc)}})


def dispatch(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    zone = str(payload.get("zone", "")).strip().lower()
    if zone not in ZONE_ASSIGNMENTS:
        raise ApiError("zone must be entrance, corridor, exhibit, or device", code="unknown_zone")
    assignment = ZONE_ASSIGNMENTS[zone]
    robot_id = str(payload.get("robot_id") or assignment["primary"])
    if robot_id not in (assignment["primary"], assignment["backup"]):
        raise ApiError("robot is not assigned to this zone", code="zone_robot_mismatch")
    status = run_readonly_status()
    if not robot_online(status, robot_id):
        raise ApiError(f"{robot_id} is offline", code="robot_offline")
    now = time.time()
    task = {
        "task_id": str(payload.get("task_id") or f"task-{int(now)}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"),
        "zone": zone,
        "route": str(payload.get("route") or assignment["route"]),
        "robot_id": robot_id,
        "state": "pending",
        "reason": "accepted_for_dispatch",
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }
    with LOCK:
        data = load_state()
        previous = data.setdefault("tasks", {}).get(task["task_id"])
        if previous:
            if all(previous.get(key) == task.get(key) for key in ("zone", "route", "robot_id")):
                return {"ok": True, "idempotent_replay": True, "task": task_public(previous)}
            raise ApiError("task_id already exists with different parameters", 409, "task_id_conflict")
        data["tasks"][task["task_id"]] = task
        save_state(data)
        actions = load_route_plans().get(task["route"], [])
        stop_event = execute_task(task, actions)
        data = load_state()
        data["tasks"][task["task_id"]] = task
        save_state(data)
        if stop_event:
            threading.Thread(target=run_actions, args=(task["task_id"], task["robot_id"], actions, stop_event), daemon=True).start()
    return {"ok": True, "task": task_public(task)}


def query_status(task_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with LOCK:
        task = load_state().get("tasks", {}).get(task_id)
    if not task:
        raise ApiError("unknown task_id", code="unknown_task")
    return {"ok": True, "task": task_public(task)}


def cancel_task(task_id: str, reason: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with LOCK:
        data = load_state()
        task = data.get("tasks", {}).get(task_id)
        if not task:
            raise ApiError("unknown task_id", code="unknown_task")
        stop_event = STOP_EVENTS.get(task_id)
        if stop_event:
            stop_event.set()
        process = RUNNING_PROCESSES.get(task_id)
        if process and process.poll() is None:
            process.terminate()
        send_stop(task["robot_id"])
        task["state"] = "cancelled"
        task["reason"] = reason[:120]
        task["updated_at"] = time.time()
        save_state(data)
    return {"ok": True, "task": task_public(task)}


def reassign_task(task_id: str, robot_id: str, reason: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    with LOCK:
        data = load_state()
        task = data.get("tasks", {}).get(task_id)
        if not task:
            raise ApiError("unknown task_id", code="unknown_task")
        if task["state"] not in ("pending", "blocked"):
            raise ApiError("only pending or blocked tasks can be reassigned", 409, "task_not_reassignable")
        assignment = ZONE_ASSIGNMENTS[task["zone"]]
        if robot_id not in (assignment["primary"], assignment["backup"]):
            raise ApiError("robot is not assigned to this zone", code="zone_robot_mismatch")
        status = run_readonly_status()
        if not robot_online(status, robot_id):
            raise ApiError(f"{robot_id} is offline", code="robot_offline")
        task["robot_id"] = robot_id
        task["state"] = "pending"
        task["reason"] = f"reassignment_pending: {reason[:100]}"
        task["updated_at"] = time.time()
        save_state(data)
        actions = load_route_plans().get(task["route"], [])
        stop_event = execute_task(task, actions)
        data = load_state()
        data["tasks"][task_id] = task
        save_state(data)
        if stop_event:
            threading.Thread(target=run_actions, args=(task_id, task["robot_id"], actions, stop_event), daemon=True).start()
    return {"ok": True, "task": task_public(task)}


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="VelaGuard M1 task API")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="0.0.0.0")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8125)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer((args.host, args.port), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

class RequestError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, status: int = 400, code: str = "invalid_request"):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.status = status
        self.code = code


STATE: dict[str, Any] = {
    "job_id": None,
    "state": "idle",
    "started_at": None,
    "finished_at": None,
    "exit_code": None,
    "request": None,
    "log_path": None,
    "report_path": None,
    "result": None,
    "message": "ready",
}
PROCESS: subprocess.Popen[str] | None = None
LOG_STREAM: Any = None


def number(value: Any, name: str, minimum: float, maximum: float) -> float:
    try:
        result = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise RequestError(f"{name} must be a number") from exc
    if result < minimum or result > maximum:
        raise RequestError(f"{name} must be between {minimum} and {maximum}")
    return result


def validate_start(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    formation = str(payload.get("formation", "square")).strip().lower()
    mission = str(payload.get("mission", "formation")).strip().lower()
    motion_mode = str(payload.get("motion_mode", "sequential")).strip().lower()
    turn_direction = str(payload.get("turn_direction", "auto")).strip().lower()
    if formation not in FORMATIONS:
        raise RequestError("unsupported formation")
    if mission not in MISSIONS:
        raise RequestError("unsupported mission")
    if motion_mode not in MOTION_MODES:
        raise RequestError("unsupported motion_mode")
    if turn_direction not in TURN_DIRECTIONS:
        raise RequestError("unsupported turn_direction")
    return {
        "formation": formation,
        "mission": mission,
        "motion_mode": motion_mode,
        "spacing": number(payload.get("spacing", 0.5), "spacing", 0.3, 2.0),
        "timeout": number(payload.get("timeout", 360), "timeout", 30, 900),
        "travel": number(payload.get("travel", 1.0), "travel", 0.1, 3.0),
        "straight": number(payload.get("straight", 0.6), "straight", 0.1, 2.0),
        "turn_radius": number(payload.get("turn_radius", 0.4), "turn_radius", 0.3, 2.0),
        "turn_direction": turn_direction,
        "cruise_speed": number(payload.get("cruise_speed", 0.15), "cruise_speed", 0.05, 0.30),
    }


def command_for(request_value: dict[str, Any], check_only: bool = False, validate_motion: bool = False) -> list[str]:
    command = [
        "cmd.exe",
        "/d",
        "/c",
        str(RUNNER),
        request_value["formation"],
        "--spacing",
        str(request_value["spacing"]),
    ]
    if check_only:
        command.append("--check-only")
        return command
    command.extend([
        "--mission",
        request_value["mission"],
        "--motion-mode",
        request_value["motion_mode"],
        "--timeout",
        str(request_value["timeout"]),
        "--travel",
        str(request_value["travel"]),
        "--straight",
        str(request_value["straight"]),
        "--turn-radius",
        str(request_value["turn_radius"]),
        "--turn-direction",
        request_value["turn_direction"],
        "--cruise-speed",
        str(request_value["cruise_speed"]),
    ])
    if validate_motion:
        command.append("--validate-motion")
    return command


def run_preflight() -> dict[str, Any]:
    with LOCK:
        if PROCESS is not None and PROCESS.poll() is None:
            raise RequestError("a formation job is running", 409, "job_running")
    request_value = validate_start({})
    deployment = subprocess.run(command_for(request_value, check_only=True), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90, check=False)
    if deployment.returncode != 0:
        raise RequestError(deployment.stdout[-4000:] + deployment.stderr[-4000:], 503, "deployment_check_failed")
    acceptance = subprocess.run([str(ACCEPTANCE_PYTHON), str(ACCEPTANCE_SCRIPT)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90, check=False)
    if acceptance.returncode != 0:
        raise RequestError(acceptance.stdout[-4000:] + acceptance.stderr[-4000:], 503, "stationary_check_failed")
    return {"ok": True, "deployment": deployment.stdout.strip(), "stationary": acceptance.stdout.strip()}


def start_job(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    global PROCESS, LOG_STREAM
    request_value = validate_start(payload)
    with LOCK:
        if PROCESS is not None and PROCESS.poll() is None:
            raise RequestError("a formation job is running", 409, "job_running")
    validation = subprocess.run(
        command_for(request_value, validate_motion=True),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
        check=False,
    )
    if validation.returncode != 0:
        output = validation.stdout[-4000:] + validation.stderr[-4000:]
        lowered = output.lower()
        if any(token in lowered for token in ("does not fit", "unsafe", "collision free", "outside_arena", "path blocked")):
            raise RequestError(output, 409, "insufficient_clearance")
        if any(token in lowered for token in ("localization", "pose missing", "pose stale", "telemetry invalid")):
            raise RequestError(output, 503, "localization_unavailable")
        if "lidar" in lowered or "scan" in lowered:
            raise RequestError(output, 503, "lidar_unavailable")
        if any(token in lowered for token in ("service", "ssh unavailable", "motor output gate")):
            raise RequestError(output, 503, "robot_service_unavailable")
        raise RequestError(output, 409, "motion_validation_failed")
    with LOCK:
        if PROCESS is not None and PROCESS.poll() is None:
            raise RequestError("a formation job is running", 409, "job_running")
        job_id = f"formation-{time.strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
        LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        log_path = LOG_DIR / f"{job_id}.log"
        LOG_STREAM = log_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8")
        PROCESS = subprocess.Popen(
            command_for(request_value),
            cwd=str(KIT_ROOT),
            stdout=LOG_STREAM,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            text=True,
            creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP,
        )
        STATE.update({
            "job_id": job_id,
            "state": "running",
            "started_at": time.time(),
            "finished_at": None,
            "exit_code": None,
            "request": request_value,
            "log_path": str(log_path),
            "report_path": None,
            "result": None,
            "message": "formation job started",
        })
        threading.Thread(target=watch_job, args=(PROCESS, log_path), daemon=True).start()
        return {"ok": True, "job": public_state()}


def watch_job(process: subprocess.Popen[str], log_path: Path) -> None:
    global LOG_STREAM
    exit_code = process.wait()
    if LOG_STREAM is not None:
        LOG_STREAM.close()
        LOG_STREAM = None
    result = None
    report_path = None
    message = "formation job completed" if exit_code == 0 else "formation job failed"
    for line in log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
        if line.startswith("FORMATION_RESULT "):
            result = json.loads(line.removeprefix("FORMATION_RESULT "))
        elif line.startswith("FORMATION_REPORT "):
            report_path = line.removeprefix("FORMATION_REPORT ").strip()
        elif line.startswith("AUTO_FORMATION_FAILED:"):
            message = line.strip()
    with LOCK:
        STATE.update({
            "state": "complete" if exit_code == 0 else "failed",
            "finished_at": time.time(),
            "exit_code": exit_code,
            "report_path": report_path,
            "result": result,
            "message": message,
        })


def stop_job() -> dict[str, Any]:
    with LOCK:
        process = PROCESS
        if process is None or process.poll() is not None:
            return {"ok": True, "job": public_state(), "already_stopped": True}
        process.send_signal(signal.CTRL_BREAK_EVENT)
        STATE["state"] = "stopping"
        STATE["message"] = "stop requested"
        return {"ok": True, "job": public_state(), "already_stopped": False}


def public_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = dict(STATE)
    log_path = value.get("log_path")
    value["recent_output"] = ""
    if log_path and Path(log_path).is_file():
        value["recent_output"] = Path(log_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")[-8000:]
    return value


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, fmt: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        return

    def send_json(self, status: int, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        raw = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(raw)

    def body(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
        if length <= 0 or length > 65536:
            raise RequestError("request body size is invalid")
        value = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode("utf-8"))
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise RequestError("request body must be an object")
        return value

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        if self.path == "/api/v1/health":
            self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "service": "formation-executor", "runner": str(RUNNER), "runner_exists": RUNNER.is_file()})
        elif self.path == "/api/v1/capabilities":
            self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "formations": sorted(FORMATIONS), "missions": sorted(MISSIONS), "motion_modes": sorted(MOTION_MODES)})
        elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/status":
            with LOCK:
                self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "job": public_state()})
        else:
            self.send_json(404, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "not found"}})

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        try:
            payload = self.body()
            if self.path == "/api/v1/formation/preflight":
                response = run_preflight()
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/start":
                response = start_job(payload)
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/stop":

            else:

        except RequestError as exc:
            self.send_json(exc.status, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": exc.code, "message": str(exc)}})
        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
            self.send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "invalid_json", "message": str(exc)}})

DEFAULT_BASE_URL = os.environ.get("FORMATION_API_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8125")


class FormationRequestError(RuntimeError):
    def __init__(self, code, message):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.code = code


def request_json(base_url, method, path, payload=None):
    body = None
    headers = {"Accept": "application/json"}
    if payload is not None:
        body = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        base_url.rstrip("/") + path,
        data=body,
        headers=headers,
        method=method,
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=180) as response:
            result = json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as exc:
        value = json.loads(exc.read().decode("utf-8"))
        error = value.get("error") or {}
        raise FormationRequestError(
            str(error.get("code") or "request_failed"),
            str(error.get("message") or error),
        ) from exc
    except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError) as exc:
        raise FormationRequestError("formation_service_unavailable", str(exc)) from exc
    if not isinstance(result, dict):
        raise RuntimeError("编队接口返回内容格式错误")
    if result.get("ok") is False:
        error = result.get("error") or {}
        raise FormationRequestError(
            str(error.get("code") or "request_failed"),
            str(error.get("message") or error),
        )
    return result


def rejection_message(code, detail):
    content = (detail or "").lower()
    if code == "insufficient_clearance" or any(token in content for token in ("does not fit", "unsafe", "collision free", "path blocked", "outside_arena")):
        return "距离不足，执行已被否定"
    if code == "localization_unavailable" or any(token in content for token in ("localization", "pose missing", "pose stale", "telemetry invalid")):
        return "定位异常，执行已被否定"
    if code == "lidar_unavailable" or "lidar" in content or "scan" in content:
        return "雷达异常，执行已被否定"
    if code in ("robot_service_unavailable", "formation_service_unavailable", "formation_executor_unavailable") or any(token in content for token in ("service", "ssh unavailable", "connection refused")):
        return "控制服务异常，执行已被否定"

        return "参数不符合要求，执行已被否定"

def runtime_failure_message(detail):

    if any(token in content for token in ("path blocked", "blocked by lidar", "does not fit", "unsafe", "collision free", "outside_arena")):

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""voice_errors.py — 语音助手"出错就用语音说一句"。

为什么非做不可（实测踩到的）
--------------------------
云端不通时，助手会**卡 90 秒然后一声不吭**。日志里明明写着
「🎤 听到唤醒词『小陈』」→ 录到了音 → `识别失败：transcribe.py timed out after
90 seconds`，但用户那边**听不到任何反馈**，只能以为"喊了没反应"。
排障全靠 SSH 看日志 —— 在现场这是不可接受的。

三条设计原则
------------
1. **先快后慢**：识别前做一次几秒的连通性预检。不通就立刻说"网络不通"，
   而不是等 ASR 超时 90 秒才出声。
2. **一定要有声音**：TTS 本身也走云端，网络不通时它**必然也失败**。
   所以每种错误都配一段**本地提示音**（板载扬声器，零依赖），先响提示音，
   再尝试 TTS 补一句人话。
3. **话要短**：现场噪音大、注意力有限，"网络不通"远好过
   "urlopen error [Errno 113] No route to host"。

额外一招：**把错误话术预合成进 TTS 缓存**（`--presynth-errors`）。
tts.py 的缓存是磁盘文件，联网时合成一次，之后**离线也能播** ——
这样"网络不通"这句话本身仍然能用语音说出来。
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import socket
import threading
import time

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ 错误表
# kind: (要说的话, 提示音频率列表)
#   提示音：两声下行短音 = 可恢复的小问题；三声下行 = 明显故障；
#           先升后降 = 安全拦截（跟正常的上行音区分开）。
ERRORS = {
    "net":      ("网络不通",             [700, 560, 440]),
    "asr":      ("识别失败",             [700, 560, 440]),
    "asr_to":   ("识别超时",             [700, 560, 440]),
    "nohear":   ("没听清",               [760, 620]),
    "nomatch":  ("没听懂",               [760, 620]),
    "unsafe":   ("这条指令不安全",       [900, 620, 420]),
    "noaction": ("这条指令还没配置",     [700, 560]),
    "execfail": ("执行失败",             [700, 560, 440]),
    "vcmderr":  ("命令解析出错",         [700, 560, 440]),
    "micbusy":  ("麦克风被占用",         [560, 440, 340]),
    "recfail":  ("录音失败",             [560, 440, 340]),
    "nomic":    ("没听到声音",           [760, 620]),
    "nocar":    ("小车联系不上",         [700, 560, 440]),
    "clearance": ("距离不足，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
    "localization": ("定位异常，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
    "lidar": ("雷达异常，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
    "service": ("服务异常，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
    "busy": ("任务占用，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
    "params": ("参数不符合要求，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
    "conditions": ("条件不足，执行已被否定", [900, 620, 420]),
}
DEFAULT = ("出错了", [700, 560, 440])

# 需要预合成的话术（联网时跑一次，之后离线也能播）
PRESYNTH = [ERRORS[k][0] for k in sorted(ERRORS)]

# 预检结果缓存：短时间内的连续失败不必反复重试（每次要几秒）
_CACHE = {"t": 0.0, "ok": True, "why": "", "ttl": 8.0}


def _hostport(proxy):
    """把 'http://192.168.1.100:7890' 拆成 ('192.168.1.100', 7890)。"""
    s = proxy.strip()
    if "://" in s:
        s = s.split("://", 1)[1]
    s = s.split("/", 1)[0]
    if "@" in s:                      # 带认证的代理
        s = s.rsplit("@", 1)[1]
    host, _, port = s.partition(":")
    try:
        return host, int(port or 80)
    except ValueError:
        return host, 80


def _tcp_ok(host, port, timeout):
    try:
        s = socket.create_connection((host, port), timeout=timeout)
        s.close()
        return True
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False


def _dns_ok(host, timeout):
    """只做解析。注意 `setdefaulttimeout` **管不住** getaddrinfo，
    所以这个函数只适合"单独想看是不是 DNS 的问题"，不要放在快路径上。"""
    old = socket.getdefaulttimeout()
    try:
        socket.setdefaulttimeout(timeout)
        socket.getaddrinfo(host, 443, proto=socket.IPPROTO_TCP)
        return True
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False
    finally:
        socket.setdefaulttimeout(old)


def _probe_once(timeout, host):
    """真正探一次。返回 (bool, 原因)。"""
    proxy = (os.environ.get("https_proxy") or os.environ.get("HTTPS_PROXY")
             or os.environ.get("http_proxy") or os.environ.get("HTTP_PROXY") or "")
    if proxy:
        # 有代理就查代理 —— 本机实测就是靠 192.168.1.100:7890 出去的，
        # 代理一挂，云端 ASR 和 TTS 会**一起**废掉。
        h, p = _hostport(proxy)
        if not _tcp_ok(h, p, timeout):
            return False, "代理 %s:%d 连不上" % (h, p)
        return True, ""
    try:
        s = socket.create_connection((host, 443), timeout=timeout)
        s.close()
        return True, ""
    except socket.gaierror:
        return False, "域名解析失败"
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        return False, "连不上云端（%s）" % type(exc).__name__


def net_ok(timeout=4.0, use_cache=True, host="dashscope.aliyuncs.com"):
    """云端走不走得通。返回 (bool, 原因)。结果缓存几秒，避免连续失败反复重试。

    【为什么要开线程】`getaddrinfo` **不受 socket 超时约束**，某些环境下
    光解析就能卡十几秒（本机实测 12 秒），那样"快预检"就名不副实了。
    这里给整次探测套一道**硬期限**；期限内没结论就返回"通"（=不拦），
    让后面的 ASR 自己去试 —— 宁可偶尔慢一次，也不要误拦掉正常的一轮。
    """
    now = time.time()
    if use_cache and (now - _CACHE["t"]) < _CACHE["ttl"]:
        return _CACHE["ok"], _CACHE["why"]

    box = {}

    def _run():
        try:
            box["r"] = _probe_once(timeout, host)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            box["r"] = (True, "")          # 探测本身出错就不拦
            box["err"] = str(exc)

    th = threading.Thread(target=_run, daemon=True)
    th.start()
    th.join(timeout + 1.5)
    if "r" not in box:
        # 没在硬期限内得出结论：不拦，交给 ASR 去试（并把结果短暂缓存）
        _CACHE.update(t=now, ok=True, why="")
        return True, ""
    ok, why = box["r"]
    _CACHE.update(t=now, ok=ok, why=why)
    return ok, why


def text_of(kind, extra=""):
    """要说的话 —— **只返回短句**。

    详细原因（"代理 192.168.1.100:7890 连不上"这种）只写进日志，**不念出来**：
    现场噪音大，念一长串 IP 和英文错误反而听不清重点，用户只需要知道
    "哪一类问题"。要细节看日志。
    """
    return ERRORS.get(kind, DEFAULT)[0]


def tones_of(kind):
    return ERRORS.get(kind, DEFAULT)[1]


def report(kind, beep_fn=None, say_fn=None, enabled=True, detail="",
           verbose=False):
    """把一条错误报出来：**先响本地提示音，再试语音**。

    beep_fn(tones)  : 播放一串频率，必须不依赖网络（板载扬声器）
    say_fn(text)    : 走 TTS；缓存命中时离线也能播
    detail          : 给日志用的详细原因，**不会被念出来**
    任何一个失败都不抛异常 —— 报错功能本身绝不能把主流程带崩。
    返回实际要说的话（便于写进日志/JSONL）。
    """
    text = text_of(kind)
    if detail and verbose:
        print("  [err] %s（详情：%s）" % (text, detail))
    if not enabled:
        return text
    # 1) 本地提示音：一定发得出来，先给用户一个"我出错了"的信号
    if beep_fn is not None:
        try:
            beep_fn(tones_of(kind))
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            if verbose:
                print("  [err] 提示音失败：%s" % exc)
    # 2) 再试语音。离线时若缓存里有这句，仍然能播出来。
    if say_fn is not None:
        try:
            say_fn(text)
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            if verbose:
                print("  [err] 语音播报失败：%s" % exc)
    return text


def presynth(verbose=True):
    """把错误话术预合成进 tts 缓存（联网时跑一次，之后离线可播）。"""
    import sys
    sys.path.insert(0, "/home/sunrise/voice_pipeline")
    try:
        import tts
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
        print("  载入 tts 失败：%s" % exc)
        return 0, 0
    ok = bad = 0
    for s in PRESYNTH:
        t0 = time.time()
        try:
            p = tts.synth(s)
            print("  ✅ 「%s」-> %s（%.1fs）" % (s, os.path.basename(str(p)),
                                              time.time() - t0))
            ok += 1
        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001
            print("  ❌ 「%s」失败：%s" % (s, exc))
            bad += 1
    return ok, bad


def selftest():
    print("=== voice_errors 自测 ===")
    ok = bad = 0
    for k in sorted(ERRORS):
        msg, tones = ERRORS[k]
        if not msg or not tones:
            bad += 1
            print("  ❌ %s 缺内容" % k)
            continue
        if len(msg) > 20:
            bad += 1
            print("  ❌ %s 话术太长（%d 字）：%s" % (k, len(msg), msg))
            continue
        ok += 1
        print("  ok   %-9s 「%s」 提示音 %s" % (k, msg, tones))
    # 拆代理字符串
    cases = [("http://192.168.1.100:7890", ("192.168.1.100", 7890)),
             ("https://user:pw@10.0.0.1:8080", ("10.0.0.1", 8080)),
             ("127.0.0.1:3128", ("127.0.0.1", 3128))]
    for s, want in cases:
        got = _hostport(s)
        if got == want:
            ok += 1
            print("  ok   _hostport(%r) = %s" % (s, got))
        else:
            bad += 1
            print("  ❌ _hostport(%r) = %s，应为 %s" % (s, got, want))
    # 连通性预检（真实执行一次）
    t0 = time.time()
    good, why = net_ok(timeout=4.0, use_cache=False)
    print("  预检：%s%s（%.1fs）"
          % ("通" if good else "不通", ("：" + why) if why else "", time.time() - t0))
    ok += 1
    print()
    print("自测：%d 通过，%d 失败" % (ok, bad))

class RequestError(Exception):

def number(value: Any, name: str, minimum: float, maximum: float) -> float:
    try:
        result = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise RequestError(f"{name} must be a number") from exc
    if result < minimum or result > maximum:
        raise RequestError(f"{name} must be between {minimum} and {maximum}")
    return result


def validate_start(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    formation = str(payload.get("formation", "square")).strip().lower()
    mission = str(payload.get("mission", "formation")).strip().lower()
    motion_mode = str(payload.get("motion_mode", "sequential")).strip().lower()
    turn_direction = str(payload.get("turn_direction", "auto")).strip().lower()
    if formation not in FORMATIONS:
        raise RequestError("unsupported formation")
    if mission not in MISSIONS:
        raise RequestError("unsupported mission")
    if motion_mode not in MOTION_MODES:
        raise RequestError("unsupported motion_mode")
    if turn_direction not in TURN_DIRECTIONS:
        raise RequestError("unsupported turn_direction")
    return {
        "formation": formation,
        "mission": mission,
        "motion_mode": motion_mode,
        "spacing": number(payload.get("spacing", 0.5), "spacing", 0.3, 2.0),
        "timeout": number(payload.get("timeout", 360), "timeout", 30, 900),
        "travel": number(payload.get("travel", 1.0), "travel", 0.1, 3.0),
        "straight": number(payload.get("straight", 0.6), "straight", 0.1, 2.0),
        "turn_radius": number(payload.get("turn_radius", 0.4), "turn_radius", 0.3, 2.0),
        "turn_direction": turn_direction,
        "cruise_speed": number(payload.get("cruise_speed", 0.15), "cruise_speed", 0.05, 0.30),
    }


def command_for(request_value: dict[str, Any], check_only: bool = False, validate_motion: bool = False) -> list[str]:
    command = [
        "cmd.exe",
        "/d",
        "/c",
        str(RUNNER),
        request_value["formation"],
        "--spacing",
        str(request_value["spacing"]),
    ]
    if check_only:
        command.append("--check-only")
        return command
    command.extend([
        "--mission",
        request_value["mission"],
        "--motion-mode",
        request_value["motion_mode"],
        "--timeout",
        str(request_value["timeout"]),
        "--travel",
        str(request_value["travel"]),
        "--straight",
        str(request_value["straight"]),
        "--turn-radius",
        str(request_value["turn_radius"]),
        "--turn-direction",
        request_value["turn_direction"],
        "--cruise-speed",
        str(request_value["cruise_speed"]),
    ])
    if validate_motion:
        command.append("--validate-motion")
    return command


def run_preflight() -> dict[str, Any]:
    with LOCK:
        if PROCESS is not None and PROCESS.poll() is None:
            raise RequestError("a formation job is running", 409, "job_running")
    request_value = validate_start({})
    deployment = subprocess.run(command_for(request_value, check_only=True), capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90, check=False)
    if deployment.returncode != 0:
        raise RequestError(deployment.stdout[-4000:] + deployment.stderr[-4000:], 503, "deployment_check_failed")
    acceptance = subprocess.run([str(ACCEPTANCE_PYTHON), str(ACCEPTANCE_SCRIPT)], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=90, check=False)
    if acceptance.returncode != 0:
        raise RequestError(acceptance.stdout[-4000:] + acceptance.stderr[-4000:], 503, "stationary_check_failed")
    return {"ok": True, "deployment": deployment.stdout.strip(), "stationary": acceptance.stdout.strip()}


def start_job(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    global PROCESS, LOG_STREAM
    request_value = validate_start(payload)
    with LOCK:
        if PROCESS is not None and PROCESS.poll() is None:
            raise RequestError("a formation job is running", 409, "job_running")
    validation = subprocess.run(
        command_for(request_value, validate_motion=True),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
        check=False,
    )
    if validation.returncode != 0:
        output = validation.stdout[-4000:] + validation.stderr[-4000:]
        lowered = output.lower()
        if any(token in lowered for token in ("does not fit", "unsafe", "collision free", "outside_arena", "path blocked")):
            raise RequestError(output, 409, "insufficient_clearance")
        if any(token in lowered for token in ("localization", "pose missing", "pose stale", "telemetry invalid")):
            raise RequestError(output, 503, "localization_unavailable")
        if "lidar" in lowered or "scan" in lowered:
            raise RequestError(output, 503, "lidar_unavailable")
        if any(token in lowered for token in ("service", "ssh unavailable", "motor output gate")):
            raise RequestError(output, 503, "robot_service_unavailable")
        raise RequestError(output, 409, "motion_validation_failed")
    with LOCK:
        if PROCESS is not None and PROCESS.poll() is None:
            raise RequestError("a formation job is running", 409, "job_running")
        job_id = f"formation-{time.strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')}-{uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]}"
        LOG_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        log_path = LOG_DIR / f"{job_id}.log"
        LOG_STREAM = log_path.open("w", encoding="utf-8")
        PROCESS = subprocess.Popen(
            command_for(request_value),
            cwd=str(KIT_ROOT),
            stdout=LOG_STREAM,
            stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            text=True,
            creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP,
        )
        STATE.update({
            "job_id": job_id,
            "state": "running",
            "started_at": time.time(),
            "finished_at": None,
            "exit_code": None,
            "request": request_value,
            "log_path": str(log_path),
            "report_path": None,
            "result": None,
            "message": "formation job started",
        })
        threading.Thread(target=watch_job, args=(PROCESS, log_path), daemon=True).start()
        return {"ok": True, "job": public_state()}


def watch_job(process: subprocess.Popen[str], log_path: Path) -> None:
    global LOG_STREAM
    exit_code = process.wait()
    if LOG_STREAM is not None:
        LOG_STREAM.close()
        LOG_STREAM = None
    result = None
    report_path = None
    message = "formation job completed" if exit_code == 0 else "formation job failed"
    for line in log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").splitlines():
        if line.startswith("FORMATION_RESULT "):
            result = json.loads(line.removeprefix("FORMATION_RESULT "))
        elif line.startswith("FORMATION_REPORT "):
            report_path = line.removeprefix("FORMATION_REPORT ").strip()
        elif line.startswith("AUTO_FORMATION_FAILED:"):
            message = line.strip()
    with LOCK:
        STATE.update({
            "state": "complete" if exit_code == 0 else "failed",
            "finished_at": time.time(),
            "exit_code": exit_code,
            "report_path": report_path,
            "result": result,
            "message": message,
        })


def stop_job() -> dict[str, Any]:
    with LOCK:
        process = PROCESS
        if process is None or process.poll() is not None:
            return {"ok": True, "job": public_state(), "already_stopped": True}
        process.send_signal(signal.CTRL_BREAK_EVENT)
        STATE["state"] = "stopping"
        STATE["message"] = "stop requested"
        return {"ok": True, "job": public_state(), "already_stopped": False}


def public_state() -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = dict(STATE)
    log_path = value.get("log_path")
    value["recent_output"] = ""
    if log_path and Path(log_path).is_file():
        value["recent_output"] = Path(log_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")[-8000:]
    return value


class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, fmt: str, *args: Any) -> None:
        return

    def send_json(self, status: int, value: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        raw = json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(raw)

    def body(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", "0"))
        if length <= 0 or length > 65536:
            raise RequestError("request body size is invalid")
        value = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode("utf-8"))
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise RequestError("request body must be an object")
        return value

    def do_GET(self) -> None:
        if self.path == "/api/v1/health":
            self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "service": "formation-executor", "runner": str(RUNNER), "runner_exists": RUNNER.is_file()})
        elif self.path == "/api/v1/capabilities":
            self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "formations": sorted(FORMATIONS), "missions": sorted(MISSIONS), "motion_modes": sorted(MOTION_MODES)})
        elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/status":
            with LOCK:
                self.send_json(200, {"ok": True, "job": public_state()})
        else:
            self.send_json(404, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "not found"}})

    def do_POST(self) -> None:
        try:
            payload = self.body()
            if self.path == "/api/v1/formation/preflight":
                response = run_preflight()
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/start":
                response = start_job(payload)
            elif self.path == "/api/v1/formation/stop":
                response = stop_job()
            else:
                raise RequestError("not found", 404, "not_found")
            self.send_json(200, response)
        except RequestError as exc:
            self.send_json(exc.status, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": exc.code, "message": str(exc)}})
        except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as exc:
            self.send_json(400, {"ok": False, "error": {"code": "invalid_json", "message": str(exc)}})


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="VelaMecanum formation executor API")
    parser.add_argument("--host", default="0.0.0.0")
    parser.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8766)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer((args.host, args.port), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()
